name: Carrying Capacity
desc: Your carrying capacity equals your Strength score multiplied by 15, in pounds. If you carry weight beyond 5 times your Strength score, you are encumbered, reducing your speed by 10 feet. Beyond 10 times your Strength score you are heavily encumbered: your speed drops by 20 feet, and you have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws that use Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. Size affects capacity: Large or larger creatures multiply these values, Tiny creatures halve them.
